title: Koala eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tree branch -->
  <rect x='8' y='78' width='84' height='8' rx='4' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='8' y='78' width='84' height='4' rx='2' fill='#A0714F'/>
  
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#9EA7B0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='16' ry='13' fill='#B8C2CC'/>
  
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='62' rx='7' ry='10' transform='rotate(-20 30 62)' fill='#9EA7B0'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='62' rx='7' ry='10' transform='rotate(20 70 62)' fill='#9EA7B0'/>
  
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='82' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#9EA7B0'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='82' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#9EA7B0'/>
  
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='24' fill='#A8B2BC'/>
  
  <!-- fluffy ears -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='24' r='12' fill='#A8B2BC'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='24' r='7' fill='#D4DCE4'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='24' r='12' fill='#A8B2BC'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='24' r='7' fill='#D4DCE4'/>
  
  <!-- face patch -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='17' fill='#C4CED8'/>
  
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='8' ry='7' fill='#3A3F4A'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#4A505C'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='4' ry='2' fill='#6A7280'/>
  
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='38' r='4' fill='#2B2F38'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='38' r='4' fill='#2B2F38'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='37' r='1.5' fill='#7A8899'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='37' r='1.5' fill='#7A8899'/>
  
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M45 54 Q50 58 55 54' stroke='#4A505C' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- leaf snack in paw -->
  <g transform='rotate(-15 70 60)'>
    <ellipse cx='70' cy='58' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#4CAF50'/>
    <ellipse cx='70' cy='58' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#66BB6A'/>
    <line x1='63' y1='58' x2='77' y2='58' stroke='#2E7D32' stroke-width='1'/>
    <line x1='70' y1='58' x2='70' y2='54' stroke='#2E7D32' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- arm holding leaf -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='60' rx='6' ry='8' transform='rotate(30 66 60)' fill='#A8B2BC'/>
</svg>
